import os
import runpy

def write_file(name: str, content: str) -> None:
    """Write content to a file with UTF-8 encoding."""
    with open(name, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(content)

# File contents
config_content = '''\nAPI_KEY = \"12345\"\n'''

utils_content = '''\nfrom config import API_KEY\n\ndef get_key():\n    return API_KEY\n'''

main_content = '''\nfrom utils import get_key\n\ndef main():\n    print(get_key())\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n'''

def main() -> None:
    write_file('config.py', config_content)
    write_file('utils.py', utils_content)
    write_file('main.py', main_content)
    # Verify the import chain by running main.py
    runpy.run_path('main.py')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
